title: TOYO to Present at Webull's Corporate Connect Webinar Series on July 29
summary: TOYO Co., Ltd. (Nasdaq: TOYO; OTC: TOYWF) ("TOYO" or the "Company"), a solar manufacturing company, today announced that Rhone Resch, the Company's Chief Strategy Officer, will present at Webull's Corporate Connect Webinar Series on Wednesday, July 29, 2026, at 1:00 p.m. Eastern Time. Mr. Resch will provide a corporate overview and discuss TOYO's global manufacturing platform, U.S. growth strategy and recent business performance. Details of the presentation are as follows: Date and Time: Wednesday, July 29, 2026 at 1:00 PM ET Presenter: Rhone Resch , Chief Strategy Officer Registration Link: here About TOYO Co., Ltd. TOYO is a solar company committed to becoming a full-service provider of solar solutions in the global market, integrating upstream production of wafers and silicon, midstream production of solar cells, downstream production of photovoltaic modules, and potentially other stages of the solar power supply chain.
